prompt: ___ unemployment is a major concern for young people in southern Europe. (escribe 'x' si no hace falta artículo)
explanation: Generalización con incontable: sin artículo.

prompt: My father is ___ engineer at a car factory.
explanation: Profesiones con a/an; engineer empieza por sonido vocálico: an.

prompt: It took me ___ hour to finish the reading section.
explanation: Hour empieza con sonido vocálico (la h es muda): an.

prompt: She is studying for ___ MBA in Barcelona.
explanation: MBA se pronuncia /em-bi-ei/: empieza por sonido vocálico.

prompt: ___ Amazon is the largest river in South America.
explanation: Los ríos llevan the.

prompt: In ___ 1990s, mobile phones became affordable.
explanation: Décadas: in the 1990s.

prompt: ___ cost of living in Tokyo is extremely high.
explanation: The + sustantivo + of que lo concreta.

prompt: Governments must do more to protect ___ environment.
explanation: The environment se considera único: siempre con the.

prompt: ___ number of schools have introduced coding classes. (= varios colegios)
explanation: A number of = varios, con verbo plural (have).

prompt: The children should learn the values such as honesty.
answers: Children should learn values such as honesty.
explanation: Generalización: children y values en plural sin artículo.

prompt: I want to work in the Japan after the graduation.
answers: I want to work in Japan after graduation.
I want to work in Japan after graduating.
explanation: La mayoría de países no llevan artículo; after graduation, sin artículo.

prompt: There was an increase in the number of the tourists.
answers: There was an increase in the number of tourists.
explanation: The number of + plural sin artículo.

prompt: My grandmother has been in ___ hospital since Monday. (está ingresada)
explanation: In hospital (inglés británico) como institución, sin artículo. En inglés americano: in the hospital.

prompt: ___ is the most widely spoken first language in the world.
explanation: Los idiomas van sin artículo (the Chinese language sí lleva the porque language es el núcleo).

prompt: Choose the correct sentence.
options: The poor often have limited access to healthcare.
Poor often have limited access to the healthcare.
The poors often have limited access to healthcare.
A poor often have limited access to healthcare.
answers: The poor often have limited access to healthcare.
explanation: The + adjetivo (sin -s) = grupo de personas; healthcare general sin artículo.

prompt: There was a sharp increase ___ the price of oil.
explanation: Increase/rise/fall/decline in + aquello que cambia.

prompt: Sales rose ___ 15% (cantidad del cambio) in the second quarter.
explanation: By indica la cantidad del cambio; to indica la cifra final.

prompt: The figure fell from 80% ___ 45% (cifra final).
explanation: From X to Y: to marca el punto final.

prompt: Social media has a huge impact ___ teenagers.
explanation: Impact/effect/influence on.

prompt: Success depends ___ hard work and a little luck.
explanation: Depend on (nunca depend of, calco de «depender de»).

prompt: Many students are interested ___ studying abroad.
explanation: Interested in + -ing.

prompt: I totally agree ___ the idea that university should be free.
explanation: Agree with an idea/person; agree on a plan; agree to a proposal.

prompt: This essay will focus ___ the economic consequences of tourism.
explanation: Focus on.

prompt: The decline in fish stocks can be attributed ___ overfishing.
explanation: Attribute X to Y.

prompt: Rural areas often lack access ___ high-speed internet.
explanation: Access to.

prompt: The demand ___ electric cars has grown rapidly.
explanation: Demand for (no demand of).

prompt: Children who are exposed ___ violence may become aggressive.
explanation: Be exposed to.

prompt: The study consists ___ three main parts.
explanation: Consist of (no consist in, salvo con sentido «radicar en»).

prompt: I'm writing ___ regard to your advertisement.
explanation: With regard to / in regard to: fórmula formal de email.

prompt: The library is closed ___ the weekend.
explanation: At the weekend (UK) / on the weekend (US); over/during también valen.

prompt: The essay is due in Monday.
answers: The essay is due on Monday.
explanation: Días de la semana con on.

prompt: She arrived to London last night.
answers: She arrived in London last night.
explanation: Arrive in (ciudad/país), arrive at (edificio); nunca arrive to.

prompt: We discussed about the problem for hours.
answers: We discussed the problem for hours.
explanation: Discuss es transitivo: sin about (pero a discussion about).

prompt: The researchers were responsible ___ collecting the data.
explanation: Responsible for + -ing.

prompt: ___ the end of the period, the figure had doubled.
explanation: By the end of = como muy tarde al final de (con past perfect).

prompt: I ___ (live) in Valencia since 2019.
explanation: Since + punto de inicio: present perfect.

prompt: The museum ___ (open) to the public in 1995.
explanation: Fecha concreta pasada: past simple.

prompt: Look at those clouds! It ___ (rain) soon.
explanation: Predicción basada en una evidencia presente: be going to.

prompt: While I ___ (study) for the TOEFL, my laptop crashed.
explanation: Acción en progreso interrumpida: past continuous.

prompt: By the time the ambulance arrived, the patient ___ (lose) a lot of blood.
explanation: Anterior a otra acción pasada: past perfect.

prompt: By 2040, the population ___ (reach) 10 billion, according to forecasts.
explanation: Acción completada antes de un momento futuro: future perfect.

prompt: Water ___ (boil) at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level.
explanation: Hecho científico: presente simple.

prompt: I ___ (not / finish) the essay yet.
explanation: Yet → present perfect.

prompt: She ___ (work) here for ten years when she finally got a promotion.
explanation: Duración hasta un momento pasado: past perfect (continuo).

prompt: I am studying English since five years.
answers: I have been studying English for five years.
I have studied English for five years.
I've been studying English for five years.
I've studied English for five years.
explanation: Calco de «estudio inglés desde hace cinco años»: present perfect + for.

prompt: Yesterday I have gone to the library.
answers: Yesterday I went to the library.
I went to the library yesterday.
explanation: Yesterday es tiempo terminado: past simple.

prompt: When I will finish my degree, I will travel.
answers: When I finish my degree, I will travel.
When I have finished my degree, I will travel.
When I finish my degree, I'll travel.
explanation: Tras when con sentido futuro: presente (no will).

prompt: The proportion of people working from home ___ steadily since 2020.
explanation: Since 2020 (hasta hoy): present perfect.

prompt: I ___ to Japan three times, and I'd love to go again.
explanation: Experiencia sin momento concreto: have been (have gone implica que sigue allí).

prompt: This time next week, I ___ my IELTS exam.
explanation: Acción en curso en un momento futuro: future continuous.
